note: The register of function identifiers. Read, never recomputed. An identifier is given once and never changes, so a name that is already here keeps its number no matter where it moves in the code. Frozen 2026-08-26 from the 455 assignments the positional scheme had produced, before the sweep was widened. RETIRED numbers are kept with the reason: a number is given once and never handed to anything else, even when it was issued by mistake and referenced nowhere.

retired.MK-CF-F-020: cashflowYear — a second twelve-month cash-flow table beside the one every screen draws (MK-XS-F-004 buildDatedGrid). Removed 2026-10-25 (FIX-BILLS, the lead's instruction on the outside review's part 8): nothing in the app, the doors or the engines called it — tests only — and it was wrong on four of five outside cases: it taxed the wage with the 401(k) left in, counted reinvested dividends as money arriving and had no debt in its outflow ($5,211.17 wage, $611.43 into a 401(k), a $250 loan: $5,128.94 in and $2,000 out, where the month table gives $4,517.51 in and $2,250 out; DEC-7938, DEC-1923, DEC-0269). Its tests now read the month table. This number is never reused.
retired.MK-CF-F-047: a pure alias of effectiveRateOnGross, itself part of a second tax function. Deleted 2026-08-27 when the two functions were collapsed into one. Retired, never reused.
retired.MK-CF-F-048: effectiveTaxRate — a second producer of the tax rate, used only by the stored income record (MK-CF-F-049 buildIncomeState): it never read a filing status, a 401(k), a state rate or a typed take-home, so a married household on $138,432.60 with $14,311.43 into a 401(k) and a 5% state rate read 15.86% where the rate in force is 10.93%. This number is never reused.
